text: At 82 minutes, Ironvale Athletic implemented a tactical shift by increasing their pressing intensity (press from 0.22 to 0.4), raising their defensive line height (0.25 to 0.37), and significantly enhancing directness of play (0.66 to 0.81) to chase the game against Redmond Rovers [#1477]. This triggered a transition from a low block and deep defensive line to a higher press and vertical attacking approach, resulting in a sharp field tilt improvement from 5.9% to 65.2% and an increase in xG from 0 to 0.69, accompanied by 5 shots and 8 box touches [#1477]. However, this more aggressive pressing led to a slight worsening in PPDA (5.5 to 6.0) and a doubling of high turnovers (1 to 2), reflecting some risk inherent in the rest-defense mechanism as Ironvale sought to create overloads and disrupt Redmond’s structured 4-3-3 high press and quick circulation system [#1477]. Despite the tactical adjustment, Redmond’s defensive solidity suppressed Ironvale’s threat, maintaining their own xG at 0.03 post-change and demonstrating effective containment within the final minutes [#1477].
